lemma zero_zero_mul (Λ Λ' : lorentzGroup) :
    (Λ * Λ').1 0 0 =  (fstCol (transpose Λ)).1 0 * (fstCol Λ').1 0 +
    ⟪(fstCol (transpose Λ)).1.space, (fstCol Λ').1.space⟫_ℝ

entries.name: spaceTime.η
entries.docstring: The metric as a `4×4` real matrix.
entries.snippet: def η : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℝ

entries.name: spaceTime.η_block
entries.snippet:
lemma η_block : η = Matrix.reindex finSumFinEquiv finSumFinEquiv (
    Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) ℝ) 0 0 (-1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ))

entries.name: spaceTime.η_reindex
entries.snippet:
lemma η_reindex : (Matrix.reindex finSumFinEquiv finSumFinEquiv).symm η =
    LieAlgebra.Orthogonal.indefiniteDiagonal (Fin 1) (Fin 3) ℝ

entries.name: spaceTime.η_off_diagonal
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma η_off_diagonal {μ ν : Fin 4} (h : μ ≠ ν) : η μ ν = 0

entries.name: spaceTime.η_symmetric
entries.snippet: lemma η_symmetric (μ ν : Fin 4) : η μ ν = η ν μ

entries.name: spaceTime.η_transpose
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma η_transpose : η.transpose = η

entries.name: spaceTime.det_η
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma det_η : η.det = - 1

entries.name: spaceTime.η_sq
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma η_sq : η * η = 1

entries.name: spaceTime.η_diag_mul_self
entries.snippet: lemma η_diag_mul_self (μ : Fin 4) : η μ μ * η μ μ  = 1

entries.name: spaceTime.η_mulVec
entries.snippet: lemma η_mulVec (x : spaceTime) : η *ᵥ x = ![x 0, -x 1, -x 2, -x 3]

entries.name: spaceTime.ηLin
entries.docstring: The metric as a bilinear map from `spaceTime` to `ℝ`.
entries.snippet: def ηLin : LinearMap.BilinForm ℝ spaceTime where

entries.name: spaceTime.ηLin_expand
entries.snippet: lemma ηLin_expand (x y : spaceTime) : ηLin x y = x 0 * y 0 - x 1 * y 1 - x 2 * y 2 - x 3 * y 3

entries.name: spaceTime.ηLin_expand_self
entries.snippet: lemma ηLin_expand_self (x : spaceTime) : ηLin x x = x 0 ^ 2 - ‖x.space‖ ^ 2

entries.name: spaceTime.time_elm_sq_of_ηLin
entries.snippet: lemma time_elm_sq_of_ηLin (x : spaceTime) : x 0 ^ 2 = ηLin x x + ‖x.space‖ ^ 2

entries.name: spaceTime.ηLin_leq_time_sq
entries.snippet: lemma ηLin_leq_time_sq (x : spaceTime) : ηLin x x ≤ x 0 ^ 2

entries.name: spaceTime.ηLin_space_inner_product
entries.snippet:
lemma ηLin_space_inner_product (x y : spaceTime) :
    ηLin x y = x 0 * y 0 - ⟪x.space, y.space⟫_ℝ

entries.name: spaceTime.ηLin_ge_abs_inner_product
entries.snippet:
lemma ηLin_ge_abs_inner_product (x y : spaceTime) :
    x 0 * y 0 - ‖⟪x.space, y.space⟫_ℝ‖ ≤ (ηLin x y)

entries.name: spaceTime.ηLin_ge_sub_norm
entries.snippet:
lemma ηLin_ge_sub_norm (x y : spaceTime) :
    x 0 * y 0 - ‖x.space‖ * ‖y.space‖ ≤ (ηLin x y)

entries.name: spaceTime.ηLin_symm
entries.snippet: lemma ηLin_symm (x y : spaceTime) : ηLin x y = ηLin y x

entries.name: spaceTime.ηLin_stdBasis_apply
entries.snippet: lemma ηLin_stdBasis_apply (μ : Fin 4) (x : spaceTime) : ηLin (stdBasis μ) x = η μ μ * x μ

entries.name: spaceTime.ηLin_η_stdBasis
entries.snippet: lemma ηLin_η_stdBasis (μ ν : Fin 4) : ηLin (stdBasis μ) (stdBasis ν) = η μ ν

entries.name: spaceTime.ηLin_mulVec_left
entries.snippet:
lemma ηLin_mulVec_left (x y : spaceTime) (Λ : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℝ) :
    ηLin (Λ *ᵥ x) y = ηLin x ((η * Λᵀ * η) *ᵥ y)

entries.name: spaceTime.ηLin_mulVec_right
entries.snippet:
lemma ηLin_mulVec_right (x y : spaceTime) (Λ : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℝ) :
    ηLin x (Λ *ᵥ y) = ηLin ((η * Λᵀ * η) *ᵥ x) y

entries.name: spaceTime.ηLin_matrix_stdBasis
entries.snippet:
lemma ηLin_matrix_stdBasis (μ ν : Fin 4) (Λ : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℝ) :
    ηLin (stdBasis ν) (Λ *ᵥ stdBasis μ)  = η ν ν * Λ ν μ

entries.name: spaceTime.ηLin_matrix_stdBasis'
entries.snippet:
lemma ηLin_matrix_stdBasis' (μ ν : Fin 4) (Λ : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℝ) :
    Λ ν μ  = η ν ν *  ηLin (stdBasis ν) (Λ *ᵥ stdBasis μ)

entries.name: spaceTime.ηLin_matrix_eq_identity_iff
entries.snippet:
lemma ηLin_matrix_eq_identity_iff (Λ : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℝ) :
    Λ = 1 ↔ ∀ (x y : spaceTime), ηLin x y = ηLin x (Λ *ᵥ y)

    λ  * ‖φ‖ ^ 2 * ‖φ‖ ^ 2 + (- μSq ) * ‖φ‖ ^ 2 + (- potential μSq (λ) φ) = 0

entries.name: StandardModel.higgsVec.potential_snd_term_nonneg

    (hV : potential μSq (λ) φ = 0) : φ = 0 ∨ ‖φ‖ ^ 2 = μSq / λ

entries.name: StandardModel.higgsVec.potential_eq_zero_sol_of_μSq_nonpos
entries.snippet:
lemma potential_eq_zero_sol_of_μSq_nonpos  (hμSq : μSq ≤ 0)
    (φ : higgsVec)  (hV : potential μSq (λ) φ = 0) : φ = 0

entries.name: StandardModel.higgsVec.potential_bounded_below_of_μSq_nonpos
entries.snippet:
lemma potential_bounded_below_of_μSq_nonpos  {μSq : ℝ}

entries.name: StandardModel.higgsVec.potential_eq_bound_discrim_zero

    (hV : potential μSq (λ) φ = - μSq ^ 2 / (4  * λ)) :

entries.name: StandardModel.higgsVec.potential_eq_bound_higgsVec_sq
entries.snippet:
lemma potential_eq_bound_higgsVec_sq (φ : higgsVec)

entries.name: StandardModel.higgsVec.potential_eq_bound_iff

lemma potential_eq_bound_iff (φ : higgsVec) :
    potential μSq (λ) φ = - μSq ^ 2 / (4  * (λ)) ↔ ‖φ‖ ^ 2 = μSq / (2 * (λ))

entries.name: StandardModel.higgsVec.potential_eq_bound_iff_of_μSq_nonpos

entries.name: StandardModel.higgsVec.IsMinOn_potential_iff_of_μSq_nonneg
entries.snippet:
lemma IsMinOn_potential_iff_of_μSq_nonneg  {μSq : ℝ} (hμSq : 0 ≤ μSq) :
    IsMinOn (potential μSq lambda) Set.univ φ ↔ ‖φ‖ ^ 2 = μSq /(2 * lambda)

entries.name: StandardModel.higgsVec.IsMinOn_potential_iff_of_μSq_nonpos
entries.snippet:
lemma IsMinOn_potential_iff_of_μSq_nonpos {μSq : ℝ} (hμSq : μSq ≤ 0) :
    IsMinOn (potential μSq lambda) Set.univ φ ↔ φ = 0

entries.name: StandardModel.higgsVec.rotateMatrix
entries.docstring:
Given a Higgs vector, a rotation matrix which puts the first component of the
vector to zero, and the second component to a real
entries.snippet: def rotateMatrix (φ : higgsVec) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ

entries.name: StandardModel.higgsVec.rotateMatrix_star
entries.snippet:
lemma rotateMatrix_star (φ : higgsVec) :
    star φ.rotateMatrix =
    ![![conj (φ 1) /‖φ‖ ,  φ 0 /‖φ‖], ![- conj (φ 0) / ‖φ‖ , φ 1 / ‖φ‖] ]

entries.name: StandardModel.higgsVec.rotateMatrix_det
entries.snippet: lemma rotateMatrix_det {φ : higgsVec} (hφ : φ ≠ 0) : (rotateMatrix φ).det = 1

entries.name: StandardModel.higgsVec.rotateMatrix_unitary
entries.snippet:
lemma rotateMatrix_unitary {φ : higgsVec} (hφ : φ ≠ 0) :
    (rotateMatrix φ) ∈ unitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ

entries.name: StandardModel.higgsVec.rotateMatrix_specialUnitary
entries.snippet:
lemma rotateMatrix_specialUnitary {φ : higgsVec} (hφ : φ ≠ 0) :
    (rotateMatrix φ) ∈ specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ

entries.name: StandardModel.higgsVec.rotateGuageGroup
entries.docstring:
Given a Higgs vector, an element of the gauge group which puts the first component of the
vector to zero, and the second component to a real
entries.snippet: def rotateGuageGroup {φ : higgsVec} (hφ : φ ≠ 0) : gaugeGroup

entries.name: StandardModel.higgsVec.rotateGuageGroup_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma rotateGuageGroup_apply {φ : higgsVec} (hφ : φ ≠ 0) :
    rep (rotateGuageGroup hφ) φ = ![0, ofReal ‖φ‖]

entries.name: StandardModel.higgsVec.rotate_fst_zero_snd_real
entries.snippet:
theorem rotate_fst_zero_snd_real (φ : higgsVec) :
    ∃ (g : gaugeGroup), rep g φ = ![0, ofReal ‖φ‖]

entries.name: StandardModel.repU1Map
entries.docstring: The 2d representation of U(1) with charge 3 as a map from U(1) to `unitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ`.
entries.snippet:
@[simps!]
noncomputable def repU1Map (g : unitary ℂ) : unitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ

entries.name: StandardModel.repU1
entries.docstring:
The 2d representation of U(1) with charge 3 as a homomorphism
 from U(1) to `unitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ`.
entries.snippet:
@[simps!]
noncomputable def repU1 : unitary ℂ →* unitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ where

entries.name: StandardModel.fundamentalSU2
entries.docstring: The fundamental representation of SU(2) as a homomorphism to `unitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ`.
entries.snippet:
@[simps!]
def fundamentalSU2 : specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ →* unitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ where

entries.name: StandardModel.repU1_fundamentalSU2_commute
entries.snippet:
lemma repU1_fundamentalSU2_commute (u1 : unitary ℂ) (g : specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    repU1 u1 * fundamentalSU2 g = fundamentalSU2 g * repU1 u1
